description: This file appears to be a C header file for serial I/O functions and basic utility functions connected to the AT91 platform. It declares functions for UART initialization, character I/O, string length, and formatted printing.

methods.name: at91_init_uarts
methods.description: Initializes UART interfaces for the AT91 platform.

methods.name: puts
methods.description: Outputs a string to the UART or serial port.

methods.name: putc
methods.description: Sends a character to the serial output.

methods.name: putchar
methods.description: Outputs a character, typically identical to putc.

methods.name: getc
methods.description: Receives a character from serial input.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: hvfprintf
methods.description: Formats and outputs data to a string using a va_list.

methods.name: printf
methods.description: Prints formatted output to the serial port.
